title: Multi-Agent Executive Assistant
description: Stateful agent workflows for executive tasks, news, meetings, email and document search.
points: Developed a stateful multi-agent assistant routing requests across task management, news briefings, meeting summaries, email drafting and document search.
Implemented LLM relevance filtering for news and extracted report structure from sample PDF/DOCX files so generated briefings follow the requested format; supported PDF and DOCX export.
Worked on PostgreSQL checkpoint connection lifecycle, async task persistence and deadline/status handling; implemented human-in-the-loop confirmation flows for Teams/Planner integration.

title: PRISM | AI Self-Reflection App
description: A bilingual iOS self-reflection product with streamed AI responses and a privacy-conscious backend.
points: Developed a bilingual iOS product and async Python backend with provider-agnostic AI responses streamed over server-sent events (SSE).
Implemented Redis-backed cost reservations and cancellation cleanup to control concurrent generation spend and release resources after interrupted requests.
Worked on subscription webhook reconciliation and account-merge consistency, alongside encrypted private text and privacy-conscious telemetry; prepared release checks and local validation.

title: LangChain Chatbot
description: A streaming chatbot with conversation memory, prompt tracing and PII anonymization.
points: Built a streaming chatbot with MongoDB-backed conversation memory and configurable bot behavior; added LangSmith prompt versioning and tracing.
Integrated Microsoft Presidio to anonymize personally identifiable information before sending content to the LLM.
